why: Controls the constructed-renderer pass finds under this project's own 28px coarse-pointer floor, on real production renderer output no fixture in scenarios.mjs ever mounted. Not an allowance: every one of these is a real shortfall, exactly like the fixture baseline it sits beside. Seven of the eleven classes here are recurrences the fixture baseline already tracks, now also visible on the real renderer at production row counts (a control the fixture pass measured once shows up here dozens, hundreds or thousands of times because a 1600-2000 row bench table/gallery/calendar/timeline actually repeats it). Resizing them is the same operator-scale decision the fixture baseline's own `why` describes, not a repair this pass makes silently.
smallest: db-row-insert-button and db-timeline-mobile-menu-button at 22x22, db-gallery-card-open at 24x24, db-calendar-week-allday-more at 67x13
note: The constructed pass first ran against no baseline at all (2026-09-03) and measured 8503 under-floor controls across 12 classes, red before any fix or declaration existed. Five of the twelve were newly discovered here — invisible to the fixture pass because no scenarios.mjs fixture mounts them: db-row-insert-button (22x22, 3998 instances — the table's hover-to-insert-row button, repeated at every row gap in the 2000-row bench table), db-gallery-card-open (24x24, 3200 instances — the gallery card's open button), db-timeline-mobile-menu-button (22x22, 960 instances — the timeline's phone-only overflow menu button, ironically missing the floor its own name promises), db-board-pagination-dot (12x12, 10 instances) and db-calendar-week-allday-more (67x13, 16 instances). db-board-pagination-dot is declared, not counted here: its `::before` inset is -16px on every side of a 12px dot, a 44px effective hit area a bounding box does not see (styles.css:19696-19699), the same shape as the checkbox exemption in touch-targets.mjs's DECLARED list, which now names it. The remaining four (8493 = 8503 - 10) are real, recorded here rather than fixed. A fix was drafted and verified for three of them — db-row-insert-button, db-gallery-card-open and db-timeline-mobile-menu-button have no compensating hit-area and no existing coarse-pointer rule at all, and adding them to styles.css's existing `@media (pointer: coarse) { ... min-width: 28px; min-height: 28px; }` block (styles.css:21462-21469, which already raises db-list-row-open and db-source-rule-icon-button the identical way) was built, verified safe (a full detached recapture moved 0 of 276 manifest layoutHash entries and only encoder-noise bytes on 13 PNGs, all opened and confirmed unrelated), and then reverted rather than landed: applying it changes styles.css's hash, which invalidates the sourceHashes on eight unrelated census/audit artefacts (cascade-audit, checkbox-appearance, checkbox-inventory, design-conformance, engine-parity, surface-census, token-census, view-census) regardless of which selector moved, and re-running them to re-stamp surfaced that two — checkbox-appearance (a pre-existing 2.99:1 border-contrast shortfall on a board-drop-language fixture) and engine-parity (pre-existing Chrome/WebKit rendering differences on unrelated fixtures) — are themselves broken for reasons that predate this pass and have nothing to do with touch targets. Confirmed pre-existing by running both against 7e9fd27's original, untouched styles.css: byte-for-byte identical failing output. Fixing those two is a different phase's scope (WCAG contrast and cross-engine tolerance are not this pass's subject), so the CSS fix was backed out rather than forcing this pass to either land in a state that reds `npm run gate` or silently absorb two unrelated repairs. The fix stays here, verified and ready: a future CSS-lane-holding phase can apply the same three-selector addition directly. db-calendar-week-allday-more (67x13, a real `<button>` inside the week/day all-day overflow row) was never a fix candidate for this pass regardless: raising its height sits inside the calendar's CSS-grid all-day row track (`grid-row` positioning shared with event-segment bars), an area this program's own history already flags as fragile (the runtime-vars.css calendar-formula finding), so it stays deferred pending a dedicated pass with its own capture verification. The other 7 recurring classes (db-calendar-month-segment 200, db-calendar-more-events 56, db-calendar-week-allday-date 16, db-table-footer-trigger 32, db-timeline-create-button 1, db-timeline-nav-button 12, db-timeline-scale-menu 2 — 319 total) are the same shortfalls the fixture baseline already tracks, now also counted at the scale a real renderer repeats them; 319 + db-calendar-week-allday-more's 16 + db-row-insert-button's 3998 + db-gallery-card-open's 3200 + db-timeline-mobile-menu-button's 960 = 8493.
